_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Uri kuri kina Klondike Solitaire. Inshingano yawe ni kuhama ibikarata vyote ku ya mirongo ya msingi.

Mizani ya Mchezo:
- Mirongo ya msingi (F1-F4): Jenga ukwezi kwa majina kutoka Ace hadi Mfalume kulingana na rangi
- Mirongo ya meza (T1-T7): Jenga ukwezi kwa rangi zinazopishana (nyekundu juu ya nyeusi, nyeusi juu ya nyekundu)
- Hisa: Chora ibikarata ku ya mirongo ya taka
- Taka (W): Bikarata ya juu inapatikana kwa kucheza

Maagizo:
- 'draw' - Chora ibikarata kutoka hisa hadi taka
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Hama ibikarata kati ya mirongo
  Mifano: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count inaweza kuwa 'all', ambayo itajaribu kuhama ibikarata vyote vilivyo wazi.
- 'forfeit' - Maliza mchezo mara moja na uweke alama yako ya sasa
- Majina ya mirongo: W (taka), F1-F4 (mirongo ya msingi), T1-T7 (mirongo ya meza)

Unaweza kutekeleza vitendo vingi katika zamu moja kwa kuzitenganisha na virambo:
  Mfano: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Ni Mfalume pekee anaweza kuwekwa kwenye mirongo ya meza tupu.
Vitendo vinafanywa kwa mpangilio - ikiwa kimoja kimekosekana, vitendo vilivyosalia vitapuuzwa.
Tumia 'forfeit' ikiwa unaamini mchezo hauwezekani kushinda.

format_error.no_brackets: Uburyo bwo gukora budafise agaciro. Gukora bikwiye kuba mu nkingi (parentès).

format_error.move_needs_args: Igisata co kwimura gisaba isoko n'ahantu. Gukoresha: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
